{{Quote|The fewer mouths at the table, the bigger my slice of pikatta pie.|Head of Teyr naturalization|<ref name="EGTPAM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>}}
The '''head of Teyr naturalization''' was an individual who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. The head once joked that fewer immigrants on the planet would correlate to less [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] to [[Diet/Legends|feed]], resulting in the head's slice of [[Pikatta Pie]] being larger.<ref name="EGTPAM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The head of Teyr naturalization was introduced in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EGTPAM" />
